name: CAPTCHA for non-EU traffic on login
description: Require CAPTCHA verification for non-EU visitors accessing /login. EU traffic passes through directly. After CAPTCHA verification, request is proxied to the backend (same as statusCode 305).

_docs.statusCode_306: CAPTCHA challenge — verifies human via Cloudflare Turnstile or Google reCAPTCHA before proxying. Requires captcha.site_key and captcha.secret_key in settings.json. After passing CAPTCHA, sets a signed cookie (default 1 hour TTL). Cookie is IP-bound and HMAC-signed to prevent forgery.
_docs.statusCode_305: Direct proxy — forwards request to redirect_uri backend
_docs.country_not_equals: Use country_key: 'not_equals' to match traffic from OUTSIDE a country/region. Combined with country: 'EU', this targets non-EU traffic.

settings_json_captcha.site_key: Your Cloudflare Turnstile or reCAPTCHA site key
settings_json_captcha.secret_key: Your Cloudflare Turnstile or reCAPTCHA secret key
